semantics.function: Combinational NOT gate: input 0 produces output 1; input 1 produces output 0.
semantics.timing: Continuous combinational response, no clock or cycle latency; simulator checks after settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement.

numeric.operation: Bitwise complement of the one-bit input
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, truncation or overflow.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit truth-table expected values, not an RTL expression copied into the oracle.
verification.cases: Check both binary input values and repeated transitions 0,1,0,1.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit top dev_tb; compile and simulation each have a finite shell timeout.
verification.success: Each comparison uses case inequality; all checks must pass and simulation prints PASS.
